package rulefixtures

import (
	"fmt"
	gorm "gorm.io/gorm"
	"strings"
)

// scenario for unbounded_in_clause_expansion: IN clauses built from request-driven collections without bound limits.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: data_access; severity: contextual.

type Asset struct {
	ID   int
	Name string
}

func FindAssetsByIDs(db *gorm.DB, ids []int) ([]Asset, error) {
	placeholders := make([]string, len(ids))
	args := make([]interface{}, len(ids))
	for i, id := range ids {
		placeholders[i] = fmt.Sprintf("$%d", i+1)
		args[i] = id
	}
	var assets []Asset
	err := db.Where("id IN ("+strings.Join(placeholders, ",")+")", args...).
		Find(&assets).Error
	return assets, err
}
